findings.evidence: Item 363 'Tacos M (1 Viande)' wizard at state 02-b-wizard-open-item-1.png shows the Viande badge as '0/1' with NO meat row ticked (all rows show '0' qty). Spec did NOT call tickPrimaryOption() for item-1 (line 313-327 of spec). Yet the Vuex sidecar 16-b-cart-three-lines-aggregate.payload.json shows item-1 cart line contains item_variations[0]={id:262,item_attribute_id:307,quantity:1,variation_name:'Viande 1',name:'Merguez'}. Same pattern for item 367 'Le Méga' at state 12 (badge '0/2' Viandes, no row ticked) — Vuex shows item_variations include Merguez x2 (id:412 + id:421) for Viande 1 + Viande 2. The wizard auto-injects a default 'Merguez' meat selection at validate without any visual indication on the operator's screen during selection. Operator believes they are validating a configurable product but the kitchen receives a fixed default that the operator never explicitly selected — different operators / customers will silently receive Merguez.
findings.fix_hint: FROZEN-ZONE (public/js/pos-wizard.js syncAndSubmit ~line 3708 + viande sync block) — owner gate required before patch. Two acceptable behaviors: (a) BLOCK validate when required N/M Viande badge has 0 selection, surface a toast 'Sélectionnez 1 Viande' (matches kiosk wizard pattern); or (b) make the default selection VISIBLE in the UI (highlight Merguez row + 1 qty + show 1/1 badge) so the operator can intentionally accept or change it. Current path silently substitutes operator intent.

findings.evidence: Wizard modal does not bind Escape to dismiss. Verified by reading public/js/pos-wizard.js lines 5871-5879 (only handler binds Ctrl+Enter for syncAndSubmit) and lines 5595-5617 (only handles Enter, ArrowRight, ArrowLeft, Backspace, number keys — no e.key === 'Escape' branch). Modal HAS role='dialog' + aria-modal + aria-labelledby (verified in 02-b-wizard-open-item-1.dom.html), so screen readers announce it as a dialog, but WCAG 2.1.2 Keyboard requires keyboard-dismissible dialogs and 2.4.3 Focus Order is broken when ESC is the universal dismiss expectation. Capture spec also flagged this self-flag #1 — reviewer confirms.
findings.fix_hint: FROZEN-ZONE (public/js/pos-wizard.js line ~5871) — owner gate required before patch. Add: `if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); var cancelBtn = wizardEl.querySelector('[data-action="cancel-wizard"]'); if (cancelBtn) cancelBtn.click(); }` inside the existing keydown handler. ~5 lines, surgical.
